# Easy Parking - Gatwick Airport Parking Meet & Greet

Easy Parking is a family-run airport parking and premium valeting provider serving London Gatwick Airport (LGW). We offer convenient and stress-free Meet & Greet valet airport parking services operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

## Core Services

### 1. Meet & Greet Airport Parking (Gatwick)
- **Description**: Drive directly to your Gatwick terminal (North or South). A professional, fully insured chauffeur meets you, inspects your car, collects the keys, and parks your vehicle in our facility. On return, your vehicle is delivered directly back to the terminal.
- **Highlights**: Zero transfers required, direct terminal drop-off and pickup, 24/7 service.

### 2. Car Wash Services
- **Full Car Wash Service**: Premium inside and outside wash. Price: **£34.99**.
- **Outside Only Car Wash**: Exterior wash and hand dry. Price: **£14.99**.

## Facility Security Standards
- **Surveillance**: 24/7 high-definition CCTV coverage monitoring all vehicle bays.
- **Perimeter Fencing**: Reinforced gated entry barriers.
- **Staffing**: Continuously staffed with trained security attendants and regular patrols.
- **Location**: Minutes away from Gatwick North & South terminals.
